description: Run JavaScript in an isolated sandbox. The only API is `polarion.<operation>(args)` (see `search`) and console.log. The code is the body of an async function: use await, return a JSON value. Limits: 30 s, 20 write calls. With dry_run: true every write is previewed, not performed.

code.description: Body of an async function, e.g. const r = await polarion.getProjects({}); return r.data.length;

dry_run.description: Preview all writes without performing them.

name: execute
title: Run Polarion script
